description: USDA and University of Arizona collaborators assembled cotton observations from Maricopa, Arizona, covering three experiment series: FACE carbon-dioxide and water treatments (10 treatment-years), AgIIS irrigation imaging with nitrogen and water (four), and FISE irrigation-scheduling, density and nitrogen trials (24). The dataset includes weather, soil, management, growth and yield information. The public Harvard Dataverse dataset API confirmed its named version 1.0 release and CC0 1.0; DataCite lists spreadsheets and documentation files. No fee was shown. Crop and irrigation modellers can validate cotton growth, water-use and scheduling simulations against contrasting treatments. The experiments share one Arizona research centre and cannot alone establish performance for other climates or cultivars. Treatment-year counts differ by series, so missing variables and table joins need checking before pooled analysis. No files were downloaded. This resource is related to the Arizona FACE wheat deposit G4-0572, but covers cotton and additional irrigation experiments. The former water-sector rejection did not assess its food-supply model use.
